item.title: From farm to table: Poppin’ Cobs’ unique popcorn expands globally
item.description: Poppin' Cobs is a unique non-GMO popcorn product that pops directly off the cob, grown, harvested, and packaged in Indiana, offering a healthy snack option for consumers, and has expanded from local farmers markets to retail locations across the country and internationally since starting in 2014.

item.title: US Southern Command strikes 3 vessels in Pacific Ocean, kills 8
item.description: The U.S. Southern Command carried out strikes Dec. 15, 2025, on three vessels in international waters, killing eight men, as part of a military campaign President Donald Trump has launched on drug smuggling from the region. The effort has seen more than 20 vessels struck and at least 90 suspected drug smugglers killed, authorities say.

item.title: Trump considers reclassifying marijuana, easing criminal penalties
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump is considering an executive order to reclassify marijuana as a Schedule III drug, which could reshape the cannabis industry, ease criminal penalties, and unlock billions in research funding.

item.title: Significant warmup with increasing winds and rain chances by Thursday | Dec. 15, 2025
item.description: After a record cold Dec. 14, 2025, and several inches of snow a day earlier, the week ahead in Indiana will bring a big warmup with rain chances, stronger winds, and a flash freeze into early Friday.

item.title: 75-year-old man arrested, accused of attempted murder in Fort Wayne shooting
item.description: A 75-year-old Fort Wayne man was arrested and preliminarily charged with attempted murder after a shooting at an intersection on Monday morning, leaving a person in a life-threatening condition.

item.title: Indiana sues 50 porn websites for violating age-verification law
item.description: Indiana government has filed a lawsuit against the operators of approximately 50 pornographic websites, alleging that they have violated the state's age-verification law and the Deceptive Consumer Sales Act by exposing children to obscene and sexually explicit content.

item.title: Indiana gun task force says it made nearly 2,800 arrests in 2025
item.description: The Indiana Crime Guns Task Force says it has taken over 1,900 guns off the streets and made nearly 2,800 arrests in 2025, contributing to a decrease in violent crime in central Indiana.

item.title: DCS hosts Awaken Christmas Outreach to serve 1,000 Indianapolis families
item.description: The Indiana Department of Child Services is hosting an 'Awaken Christmas Outreach' event to distribute grocery boxes filled with fresh produce and meat to 1,000 Indianapolis families in need.

item.title: Indiana couple arrested for exposing 10-month-old child to illegal drug
item.description: A husband and wife from southern Indiana, David S. Foutch and Angela M. Foutch, were arrested after being accused of exposing a 10-month-old child to an illegal drug, leading to the infant's hospitalization in a life-threatening condition.

item.title: Martin University terminates all staff amid financial crisis
item.description: Martin University has terminated all employees due to lack of funds, with no indication of when they will be paid or if they will be rehired.
